title: Casino Geolocation Analytics Event
description: Schema for geolocation tracking events across casino/gaming properties including patron apps, employee badges, asset tags, and vehicle GPS

event_id.description: Unique UUID for this geolocation event

device_id.description: Unique identifier of the tracking device or application instance

device_type.description: Category of the device emitting the geolocation signal

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC date-time when the location was captured

altitude_meters.description: Altitude above mean sea level in meters

accuracy_meters.description: Estimated horizontal accuracy radius of the GPS fix in meters

speed_mps.description: Speed of the device in meters per second

heading_degrees.description: Direction of travel in degrees from true north (0-360)

h3_index.description: Uber H3 hexagonal hierarchical spatial index for aggregation and geospatial joins

geofence_id.description: Identifier of the geofence zone the device is within or transitioning

geofence_name.description: Human-readable name of the geofence zone, e.g. 'Main Casino Floor', 'VIP Lounge'

geofence_dwell_seconds.description: Cumulative time in seconds the device has remained inside the current geofence

poi_name.description: Name of the nearest point of interest, e.g. 'High Limit Slots', 'Buffet Entrance'

poi_distance_meters.description: Distance in meters from the device to the nearest point of interest

floor_level.description: Indoor floor level for multi-story venue positioning

indoor_zone.description: Indoor positioning zone identifier for sub-floor granularity, e.g. 'SLOT_ZONE_A3', 'TABLE_PIT_2'

proximity_trigger.description: Action triggered by the device entering a proximity region

source_system.description: Positioning technology that produced this location fix

battery_level.description: Device battery charge level as a percentage

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the pipeline
